Save a screenshot of the phone's screen as a PNG or JPEG file, scaled by
--scale (0.5 by default; 0.5 and JPEG while the remote mode is on). Without -o
it goes to screenshots/ in this folder.

Usage:
  adbuddy screenshot [flags]

Examples:
  adbuddy screenshot
  adbuddy screenshot --scale 1 -o screen.png
  adbuddy screenshot --format jpeg --json

Flags:
      --format string   png or jpeg (default: from -o's extension, else png; jpeg in remote mode)
  -h, --help            help for screenshot
  -o, --output string   file to write (default: screenshots/<date>-<time>.png or .jpg)
      --scale float     size relative to the screen, more than 0 and at most 1 (default 0.5; 0.5 and JPEG in remote mode)

Global Flags:
      --json   print machine-readable JSON on stdout
